easy.def: A very rich and powerful businessperson.
examples: The tycoon owned many shops.
A tycoon built the tower.
The tycoon was rich.

more.def: A person who has become very rich and powerful in business.
examples: The tycoon owned many shops in the city.
In the old days, a railroad tycoon built the station.
The tycoon gave money to build a new library.
A little tyke ran by.
The tyke giggled.
What a cute tyke!
A little tyke toddled across the yard.
The tyke giggled with glee.
The tykes played in the sandbox.
What type of dog is it?
This type of bird sings.
Which type do you want?

more.def: A group of things that are alike in some way.
examples: What type of music do you like?
This type of berry grows only in cold places.
There are many types of clouds.
I type my name.
She types fast.
He typed the story.

more.def: To write words by pressing keys on a keyboard.
examples: I typed my report on the computer.
She can type very fast.
Type your name at the top.

easy.def: An old machine with keys that prints letters on paper.
examples: Grandpa has a typewriter.
The typewriter clicked.
I typed on a typewriter.

more.def: A machine with keys that you press to print letters on a sheet of paper, used before computers.
examples: Grandpa has an old typewriter in his study.
The typewriter clicked and rang as I typed.
Long ago, writers used a typewriter to write their stories.
A typewritten letter.
The typewritten page.
A typewritten note.
He sent a typewritten letter.
The typewritten page had a few smudges.
Grandma kept a typewritten note.

easy.def: A very strong storm with heavy wind and rain in Asia.
examples: A typhoon hit the coast.
The typhoon was strong.
We saw a typhoon on TV.

more.def: A very strong storm with heavy rain and powerful winds that forms over the western Pacific Ocean.
examples: A typhoon hit the coast of Japan with heavy rain and strong winds.
The typhoon caused floods in the town.
Ships stayed in the harbor until the typhoon passed.
It was a typical day.
A typical cat likes to nap.
The typical lunch is a sandwich.

more.def: Showing the usual features of its kind.
examples: A typical morning begins with breakfast and a walk to school.
It is typical for kittens to sleep a lot.
The typical house on our street has a big yard.
The typist typed fast.
A typist works at a desk.
She is a typist.

more.def: A person whose job is to type on a keyboard.
examples: The typist typed the letter very fast.
A typist works at the office desk.
She became a typist after she finished school.

easy.def: A small mistake made while typing.
examples: I made a typo.
There is a typo.
Fix the typo.

more.def: A small mistake made while typing or printing.
examples: I found a typo in my story.
The teacher circled the typo in red.
A typo made the word look wrong.
A tyrannosaur was huge.
The tyrannosaur had sharp teeth.
I drew a tyrannosaur.

more.def: A very large meat-eating animal from long ago.
examples: A tyrannosaur had small arms and huge teeth.
The tyrannosaur walked on two strong legs.
We saw a tyrannosaur skeleton in the museum.

easy.def: A giant meat-eating dinosaur with tiny arms.
examples: The tyrannosaurus was huge.
A tyrannosaurus had sharp teeth.
We saw a tyrannosaurus in the museum.

more.def: A huge, meat-eating dinosaur that walked on two legs, with a big head, sharp teeth and tiny arms; also called T. rex.
examples: The tyrannosaurus was one of the biggest meat-eating dinosaurs.
The museum has a huge tyrannosaurus skeleton in the main hall.
A tyrannosaurus had a mouth full of teeth as long as bananas.
The people lived under tyranny.
The tyranny was harsh.
The king's tyranny.

more.def: Rule by someone who uses power in a cruel and unfair way.
examples: The people lived under the king's tyranny.
They rose up against tyranny.
The story told how the villagers escaped from tyranny.
The tyrant was cruel.
People feared the tyrant.
The tyrant ruled the land.

more.def: A ruler who uses power in a cruel and unfair way.
examples: The tyrant made unfair laws.
The people were happy when the tyrant lost his power.
In the story, the tyrant kept the best food for himself.
